$comment: Accepted duplicated lines per file pair, plus generated files whose duplication is the generator's output shape. A `pairs` value is the line count on its own, or `{"lines": N, "reason": "…"}` when somebody looked at the duplication and decided it stays. `pnpm check jscpd-rust` shrink-wraps the numbers, so a reason is the only part written by hand. Adding an entry, or raising a number, needs David's OK (`.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md`).

exempt.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/intl/shipped_: generated by apps/desktop/scripts/gen-shipped-locales.ts; the `zh` and `zh-Hant` entries carry the same CLDR `region_scripts` data because that is what CLDR says, so the clone tracks the shipped-locale table and no extraction can remove it

crates/cmdr-adb/src/volume/volume_impl.r.reason: `Volume` trait-method signatures again, in five blocks: the three `list_directory*` beside `max_concurrent_ops`, the `get_metadata` / `exists` / `is_directory` stat group, `open_read_stream_at_offset`, the `create_file` / `create_directory` / `create_directory_all` group, and `notify_mutation` beside the three `scan_for_*`. Every body is one line delegating to an inherent `*_impl` or straight to `cmdr_fs::volume`. Same trade as the `cmdr-sftp` ↔ `cmdr-webdav` entry: folding these takes a macro that emits trait methods, which costs more lines than it removes and hides every one from `codegraph_search` and go-to-definition. ❗ This pair GREW (82 → 117) when `cmdr-adb` dropped its own tree walk and listing patcher for `scan_walk` and `patching`: the last block matches only because both backends now delegate to the same shared code, so the number rising is what sharing the logic looks like from here. Revisit when a body stops being a one-line delegation, or when enough backends land that the macro pays for itself.

crates/cmdr-sftp/src/volume/volume_impl..reason: `Volume` trait-method signatures, not logic: the listing and file-creation blocks, where every body is one line delegating to an inherent `*_impl`. The trait makes each backend spell the full signature out, so folding these takes a macro that emits trait methods: roughly 120 lines of macro to remove about 38 lines per backend, so the code gets no smaller, and every generated method goes invisible to `codegraph_search` and to go-to-definition. The behavior behind the signatures is already shared, in `cmdr_fs::volume` (`scan_walk`, `mkdir_all`, `patching`, `secret_store`) and `network::connect_wiring`. Revisit when a body stops being a one-line delegation, or when enough backends land that the macro pays for itself.

crates/cmdr-smb/src/volume/volume_impl.r.reason: `Volume` trait-method signatures again, here `attempt_reconnect` and `reconnect_with_credentials`, both one-line delegations to `self.inner.do_*`. Same trade as the `cmdr-sftp` ↔ `cmdr-webdav` entry: a macro emitting trait methods costs more lines than it removes and hides them from symbol search. Revisit when a body stops being a one-line delegation.
